title: Social Vr
content:
- ### Definition
  - Virtual reality platforms designed for social interaction and community building, enabling users to gather in customizable three-dimensional spaces as expressive avatars with spatial audio, gesture support, and real-time communication capabilities transcending geographical limitations.

- ### Semantic Classification
  - owl-class:: spatial-computing:SocialVr
  - owl-role:: Concept
  - belongs-to-domain:: [[metaverse]]

- ### Relationships
  - is-subclass-of:: [[Virtual Reality Platform]]
  - enables:: [[Virtual Social Presence]]

- ### Content

  - #### Leading Platforms
		- VRChat (user-generated worlds)
		- Meta Horizon Worlds (Meta ecosystem)
		- Rec Room (casual and family-friendly)
		- AltspaceVR (enterprise events)
		- Somnium Space (blockchain integration)
  - #### Key Features
		- Customizable avatar representation
		- Spatial audio for natural conversation
		- User-created virtual environments
		- Real-time gesture and expression tracking
		- Cross-platform accessibility
